set +e
lake env lean "$target"

set -e

after_mtime="'$(stat -c %Y "$target")

printf '"'lean_status=%s\\nelapsed_seconds=%s\\nafter_hash=%s\\nafter_mtime=%s\\n' \""'$lean_status" "$elapsed" "$after_hash" "$after_mtime"

set +e

printf '"'lean_status=%s\\nelapsed_seconds=%s\\nafter_hash=%s\\nafter_mtime=%s\\n' \""'$lean_status" "$elapsed" "$after_hash" "$after_mtime"

path="MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf.lean"

head_ref=$("$HORIZON_GIT" symbolic-ref -q HEAD)
private_index=$(mktemp /tmp/ajcr-abel-quotient-index.XXXXXX)
cleanup_index() {
  if [ -f "$private_index" ]; then
    unlink "$private_index"
  fi
}
trap cleanup_index EXIT INT TERM
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$private_index" "$HORIZON_GIT" read-tree "$head_before"
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$private_index" "$HORIZON_GIT" add -- "$path"
cached_paths=$(GIT_INDEX_FILE="$private_index" "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --name-only "$head_before")
if [ "$cached_paths" != "$path" ]; then
  printf '"'unexpected_cached_paths=%s\\n' \""'$cached_paths"
  exit 65
fi
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$private_index" "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --name-status "$head_before"
tree=$(GIT_INDEX_FILE="$private_index" "$HORIZON_GIT" write-tree)
commit=$("$HORIZON_GIT" commit-tree "$tree" -p "$head_before"   -m "feat(picard): prove raw Pic0 big-etale descent"   -m "Summary: Prove presented and arbitrary affine singleton etale descent for the raw Pic0 Sigma functor, then reduce the big-etale sheaf condition to Zariski descent plus those singleton covers."   -m "Archon-Commit: agent

"$HORIZON_GIT" update-ref "$head_ref" "$commit" "$head_before"
printf '"'head_before=%s\\ncommit=%s\\nhead_ref=%s\\n' \""'$head_before" "$commit" "$head_ref"
"$HORIZON_GIT" show --stat --oneline --summary "$commit"'

/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
source_file="AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf.lean"
root_file="AlgebraicJacobian.lean"
artifact=".lake/build/lib/lean/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf.olean"
lock="/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock"
owner_pid=$$
cleanup_lock() {
  if [ -f "$lock/pid" ] && [ "$(tr -d '"'\\n' < \""'$lock/pid")" = "$owner_pid" ]; then
    unlink "$lock/pid"
    rmdir "$lock"
  fi
}
if ! mkdir "$lock"; then
  printf '"'mutex_busy=%s\\n' \""'$lock"
  exit 75
fi
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$owner_pid" > "$lock/pid"
trap cleanup_lock EXIT INT TERM
source_before=$(sha256sum "$source_file" | cut -d '"' ' -f 1)
root_before="'$(sha256sum "$root_file" | cut -d '"' ' -f 1)
head_before="'$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
artifact_before=$(stat -c '"'%Y:%s' \""'$artifact" 2>/dev/null || printf '"'absent')
started="'$(date +%s)
printf '"'owner_pid=%s\\nhead_before=%s\\nsource_before=%s\\nroot_before=%s\\nartifact_before=%s\\n' \""'$owner_pid" "$head_before" "$source_before" "$root_before" "$artifact_before"
set +e
lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf
build_status=$?
set -e
finished=$(date +%s)
source_after=$(sha256sum "$source_file" | cut -d '"' ' -f 1)
root_after="'$(sha256sum "$root_file" | cut -d '"' ' -f 1)
head_after="'$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
artifact_after=$(stat -c '"'%Y:%s' \""'$artifact" 2>/dev/null || printf '"'absent')
elapsed="'$((finished - started))
printf '"'build_status=%s\\nelapsed_seconds=%s\\nhead_after=%s\\nsource_after=%s\\nroot_after=%s\\nartifact_after=%s\\n' \""'$build_status" "$elapsed" "$head_after" "$source_after" "$root_after" "$artifact_after"
if [ "$source_before" != "$source_after" ] || [ "$root_before" != "$root_after" ]; then
  printf '"'verified_files_changed=true\\n'
  exit 74
fi
exit \""'$build_status"'
